title: A monster with a human face looks up at Jin, begs him to kill it, and Jin does . . . (highlight)

segments.say: A monster with a human face looks up at Jin, begs him to *kill* it, and Jin does.
In the yard, lowborn cadets whisper that Jin is only a four-star who gets all the *luck*.
Their leader Kazine Romero wants somebody to do something about it. Somebody turns around. It's *Jin*.
Jin asks how Kazine's arm is. Kazine thanks him for chopping it off so *cleanly*, because it made reattaching easier.
Kazine says Jin only has to say the word to get him *whipped*. Jin says he'd never. Kazine says he's being insolent on purpose.
Jin points out that Kazine is a five-star, one of the best cadets in the class, so why talk behind his *back*?
Then he lifts his sword and says don't go easy, go *all-out*. Main-character energy, honestly.
Kazine says you'll regret it and swings with everything he's got. That was *his* first mistake.
Steel clashes, but Jin can see every move. He has seen this swing *before*.
Kazine's last trick is an aura attack that kills any four-star knight, and Jin takes it *head-on*.
Jin was a five-star the whole time. At fifteen. He only fights when he knows he can *win*.
The word spreads fast. Two cadets stare across the hall and ask if Jin really beat *Kazine*. No way.
Kazine's boss isn't buying it either. She asks if he was *bribed* to lose, and he swears he'd never.
Everyone in the hall saw that aura. Jin has shown the whole clan his *teeth*, so she sends some of her own people along on his next *mission*.
The full story is on our channel.
